title: Acknowledged work versus recoverable work
method: Synthetic forced-failover example: 10,000−9,970=30 orders, or 30/10,000=0.3%. A record gap does not by itself establish a time-based RPO.
alt: Acknowledged work versus recoverable work: Acknowledged 10000 orders, Recoverable 9970 orders, Needs reconciliation 30 orders. Illustrative inputs.
